newsitem.title: FRANCE: French girls chase teachers for 13 years.
newsitem.headline: French girls chase teachers for 13 years.

text.p: Two young French women were given two-year suspended prison terms on Thursday for harassing their former sports teachers for 13 years, declaring their love on the telephone day and night and hunting them down when they moved.
"They were after us from morning to evening, and during the night. It was madness, hell," one of the two teachers, Patrick Sansas, told reporters after the court hearing in Toulouse.
The court was told that Corinne Jouannot and Patricia Pere, both now 27, pursued the two men even after they married, became fathers and moved from Paris to Toulouse.
They hired detectives to track them down, mailed them babies' clothes with messages saying they wanted to bear their children and used a drill to break into the home of one man.
"We were kids when it started," Jouannot told reporters, adding the girls' love had now died out. "Psychologists let us understand that we ruined our life, and theirs."
The court banned them from residing in the southwestern Toulouse region.
